caption: The drawing displays a detailed architectural or furniture design rendered in black ink on a beige background with some signs of aging, such as a yellowed bottom edge and faint stains. The composition features the frontal and side views of an ornate chest of drawers with multiple handles and keyholes. The chest is topped with elaborate decorative elements: at the center is a sculpted bust of a woman placed on a lattice-like pedestal, flanked on either side by two urns with finials and draped garlands, resting on their own pedestals. To the left of the central bust, an intricate scroll with a spiral volute rises upwards, filled with ornamental flourishes. The right section of the composition includes a profile view of the chest’s decorative top, highlighting the female bust and urn above a fluted column with carved scrolling patterns. The entire drawing is linear, with no shading, and employs precise, consistent line work throughout. Several small letter annotations and dimension lines appear on the drawing, indicating design notes or measurements.
title: Chest
